## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng commentary by [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1) Gāoyuán Míngyù (the Wàn-lì-era Yogācāra revivalist) on Dignāga's [KR6n0112](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0112) *Guān suǒyuányuán lùn* 觀所緣緣論 (T31n1624, in [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s translation). Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X51n0830. The function-marker *huìshì* 會釋 ("synthetic explication") indicates a commentary that gathers together (*huì*) and reconciles the various exegetical lines that had developed around the text — both in the Indian Yogācāra (Dharmapāla, etc.) and in the post-Kuījī Cí'ēn-school tradition.

**Abstract**

The *Huìshì* presents Dignāga's argument as a binary diagnostic: any candidate for the role of *suǒyuányuán* must satisfy both the *yǒujìng* (being-an-object) condition and the *yǐnshēng* (causally-generating) condition; the *paramāṇu* satisfies the second but not the first; the aggregated cluster satisfies the first but not the second; therefore neither external candidate works, and the *suǒyuányuán* must be the inner *xiāngfēn* 相分 (image-portion) of consciousness itself — the canonical Yogācāra *vijñapti-mātra* conclusion. Míngyù's commentary works through this symmetric refutation in detail and integrates the Cí'ēn-school treatment found in the *Chéng wéishí lùn* 成唯識論 (T31n1585) and in [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s lost *Shū* on the *Guān suǒyuányuán lùn*.

The dating window 1590–1620 brackets Míngyù's productive Wàn-lì-era period; this is one of his three commentaries on the *Guānsuǒyuán* corpus (alongside [KR6n0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0116) *Shìjì* — his commentary on Dharmapāla's *vṛtti* — and the *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn zhuìyán* [KR6n0105](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0105)). Together they form Míngyù's principal contribution to the late-Míng Yogācāra revival's recovery of Dignāga's *pramāṇa* corpus.
